footnotes: From pre-tax loss to net loss to Black Rock Coffee Bar: includes $16.5M of losses allocated to noncontrolling interests. No per-share figures were reported for the prior year.

Figures are from the company's Form 10-K for fiscal years ended Dec 31, 2025 and a year earlier, as filed with the SEC (income statement lines as the filing presents them); free cash flow = operating cash flow − capital expenditures. Never estimated: items the filing does not report are left out.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: Revenue rose 24.5% to $200M in 2025. Gross margin was 71.9%, versus 71.1% a year earlier, and operating income fell 85.1% to $901K, a 0.4% margin.
The net loss narrowed to $60K, or $0.00 per share, from $7.2M. Operating cash flow was $2.2M and free cash flow −$32.7M, versus −$8.9M.
